claim_text: The intent of this milestone was achieved in FY2025.
metric_name: Northern Goldfields catchment regional water working group first meeting
context_text: Pampe Norte FY2024 Facilitate establishment of a Northern Goldfields catchment regional water working group.；The intent of this milestone was achieved in FY2025.；BHP participated in, rather than facilitated the establishment of, the Northern Goldfields catchment regional water working group. This was following the establishment of the working group by the Tijwarl Aboriginal Corporation, which occurred after this milestone was set. The first meeting that BHP participated in was held in February 2025.
label: Suspected Greenwash
